audit_scope.description: This audit covers EL P2P networking changes (eth/69 protocol from EIP-7642), CL P2P changes for PeerDAS (Fulu P2P data column gossip, req/resp, peer discovery, custody, and fork transition), and the eth_config JSON-RPC method (EIP-7910). EIP-7910 is noted as out-of-scope for the bug bounty since it requires a publicly exposed JSON-RPC API.

in_scope: P2P Network (eth/69 handshake, history range, receipt transfer)
P2P Network (data column gossip, req/resp, peer discovery)

out_of_scope_reasons.JSON-RPC API: Vulnerabilities requiring the user to have publicly exposed an API, such as JSON-RPC, are explicitly out-of-scope per Ethereum Fusaka Bug Bounty
out_of_scope_reasons.Beacon API: Vulnerabilities requiring the user to have publicly exposed an API, such as the Beacon API, are explicitly out-of-scope
out_of_scope_reasons.Configuration: Requires node operator error, not external attack
out_of_scope_reasons.High-effort DoS attacks: Sustained, CPU or bandwidth intensive, and/or requires more than 1 packet or on-chain transaction

misclassified_entities.reason: EIP-7910 eth_config is a JSON-RPC method. The JSON-RPC API is explicitly out-of-scope for the Fusaka Bug Bounty. The RPC Client entity interacts via an out-of-scope interface.
Defined in EIP-7910 error-handling subgraph. Attacks via eth_config JSON-RPC are out-of-scope since they require a publicly exposed API.
Defined in EIP-7910 context for dishonest eth_config responses via JSON-RPC. Out-of-scope interface. However, a malicious node interacting via P2P is covered by EXT-P2P-PEER-NODE.

Local validator set is under operator control (SEMI_TRUSTED). Configuration issues requiring operator error are typically out-of-scope per bug bounty trust assumptions. Retained as entity because the supernode threshold logic is a Fusaka-specific change.

trusted_external_entities.name: Remote Peer Node via devp2p (eth/69)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: eth/69 P2P protocol (Status handshake, BlockRangeUpdate message 0x11, GetReceipts/Receipts)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peers are unauthenticated. Any node can join and send arbitrary protocol messages. All P2P input must be fully validated. Covers EIP-7642 handshake, history range updates, and receipt transfer.

trusted_external_entities.name: Gossip Network Peer via libp2p (CL)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: CL gossip peers are unauthenticated. Any peer can publish data column sidecars or beacon blocks on gossip subnets. All gossip messages must pass the full validation pipeline (structural, subnet, timeliness, signature, parent, inclusion proof, KZG proof, anti-equivocation, proposer index).

trusted_external_entities.name: Requesting Peer via CL Req/Resp Protocol
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any connected peer can send req/resp requests. Requests must be validated against serve range, epoch eligibility, and response size limits (MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS).

trusted_external_entities.name: discv5 Discovery Network
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: discv5 ENR records (eth2 fork digest, cgc, nfd fields)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Discovery network is unauthenticated. Peers can advertise arbitrary ENR records including false custody_group_count or fork digest values. All ENR fields must be validated before trust decisions.

trusted_external_entities.name: Local Execution Layer via Engine API (engine_getBlobsV2)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT. The CL explicitly skips KZG verification for blobs retrieved from the local EL via engine_getBlobsV2. If the EL is compromised or buggy, corrupted data columns would be produced and propagated to the network. This is a critical trust boundary: the CL trusts the EL for blob data integrity.

trusted_external_entities.name: Local Validator Set (supernode threshold)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Local validator balance query for supernode threshold check (>= 4096 ETH)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Local validator configuration is under operator control. The supernode threshold (4096 ETH combined balance) determines whether a node must subscribe to all data column subnets. Incorrect balance reporting could cause a node to under-serve its custody obligations.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full validation of networkid, genesis hash, and forkid required. Peers with incompatible values must be disconnected. The removal of totalDifficulty from the handshake (EIP-7642) must not create compatibility issues with post-merge nodes.
Peers may claim false block ranges. Rate limiting (max once per epoch) should be enforced. Peers that fail to serve claimed ranges should be penalized via peer scoring.
Receipt data received without bloom filters (eth/69 format) must be parsed safely. Bloom filter recomputation from logs must handle adversarial log data without excessive resource consumption.

Full 13-step validation pipeline must be applied: (1) structural validity, (2) correct subnet, (3) slot timeliness, (4) above finalization, (5) proposer signature, (6) parent seen, (7) parent valid, (8) slot > parent slot, (9) finalized checkpoint ancestry, (10) KZG commitments inclusion proof, (11) KZG column proofs, (12) anti-equivocation uniqueness, (13) expected proposer index. Failure to apply any step could allow invalid sidecars to be accepted.

Request parameters (start_slot, count, columns) must be validated against the data_column_serve_range. Response size must be bounded by MAX_REQUEST_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS. Responses must be ordered by (slot, column_index).
Block roots must be checked against minimum_request_epoch. Only sidecars that pass gossip validation may be returned. Response size must be bounded.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: discv5 ENR parsing and peer evaluation
boundary_edges.security_assumption: ENR fields (eth2, cgc, nfd) must be validated. Peers with insufficient custody_group_count MAY be rejected. Fork compatibility via nfd must be checked. Peers must not be disconnected before fork boundary for nfd mismatches.

Engine API is authenticated via JWT. Blob data from EL is used WITHOUT KZG verification. If EL is compromised, corrupted data columns will be produced and propagated to the gossip network. This is a critical trust assumption: the CL trusts EL blob integrity completely for the distributed publishing flow.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Supernode threshold evaluation (combined validator balance >= 4096 ETH)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Validator balance data must be accurate. Incorrect threshold evaluation could cause a high-stake node to not activate supernode mode, reducing network data availability capacity.

notes: EIP-7910 (eth_config) entities (EXT-RPC-CLIENT, EXT-ATTACKER, EXT-MALICIOUS-NODE) excluded from trust model as they interact via JSON-RPC API which is explicitly out-of-scope for the Fusaka Bug Bounty.
The Fulu P2P fork transition subgraph has no external entities (internal state transitions only).
EIP-7910 config structure and validation subgraphs have no external entities (internal state machines).
